caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a hand-held stamp with a round face and a short handle. The handle is broad at the base and narrows slightly before meeting the circular top. The top of the stamp features an ornate, symmetrical design with swirling, petal-like shapes in dark brown and black hues. Around the edge of the circular face is a border containing small, evenly spaced triangular shapes. The entire object is rendered in shades of brown, with darker tones used to create shading and depth, and the background is left plain and uncolored, emphasizing the object in the center of the composition.
title: Zoar Butter Mold
